title: gatsby-config siteUrl is the amplifyapp.com URL; no canonical, robots or sitemap
description:
**Problem**
The site's configured siteUrl is the Amplify preview domain rather than https://tactus.anth.us, and there is no canonical link, robots.txt or sitemap.

**Evidence**
gatsby-config.js:15: `siteUrl: `https://main.dfkbdffs2viq8.amplifyapp.com/``.

**Fix**
Set siteUrl to https://tactus.anth.us, add canonical tags, robots.txt and a sitemap (gatsby-plugin-sitemap).

**How to verify**
`curl -s https://tactus.anth.us/sitemap-index.xml -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}'` returns 200 and `grep siteUrl gatsby-config.js` shows tactus.anth.us.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
